enchantments.tooltip: Insightful Constitution +6: This item gives the wearer improved health, granting a +6 Insight bonus to Constitution.
Physical Sheltering +34: +34 Enhancement bonus to Physical Resistance Rating
Protection +11: Passive: +11 Deflection bonus to Armor Class.

Shield +13: While this item is equipped, you are partially protected by a field of magical force which can deflect enemy attacks. This item provides a +13 Shield bonus to Armor Class. It does not stack with an equipped shield.

Legendary Elemental Energy: Harnessing a small amount of power and potential of the raw elements, this item gives you a +150 bonus to your maximum spell points. This stacks with all bonuses except for Legendary Elemental Energy.

Legendary Saltmarsh Explorer: 5 Pieces Equipped:+30 Artifact bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Rating+15 Artifact bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power+3 Artifact bonus to all Ability Scores+30 Artifact Bonus to Positive, Negative, and Repair Amplification
